briefing: Stocks rose modestly today. The NASDAQ gained 1.1% and the S&P 500 gained 0.5%, which counts as a neutral session, not a strong risk-on day. Cash is $345.88, below the $500 minimum for a new buy, so I kept all 7 positions and made no trades. The stop-loss and profit-target rules will handle exits automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor keeps on hand so they can buy when a really good chance comes along. Today there was too little cash for a sensible new position and the market was only neutral, so holding the cash was the disciplined choice. Waiting for a strong signal usually works better than putting small amounts of money into ordinary setups.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「銀彈」（Dry Powder）是指投資者手上預留的現金，待真正好的入市機會出現時再動用。今日可用現金不足以建立合理倉位，加上大市走勢中性，因此保留現金是有紀律的做法。耐心等待強勁訊號，通常比把小額資金投入平平無奇的機會更好。

market_education.summary_en: Stocks rose on Friday and growth names led, with the NASDAQ up 1.1% against a 0.5% gain for the S&P 500. Some speculative areas such as quantum computing (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS), nuclear energy (OKLO, LEU) and crypto miners (RIOT) showed strong short-term momentum. Big semiconductor names like NVDA, MU and AMD stayed below their 20-day averages, though, so the rally was uneven and not a broad risk-on move. No news headlines came with today's data, so this summary is based only on index moves and the technical signals.
market_education.summary_zh: 週五美股溫和走高，成長股領漲，納斯達克指數上升1.1%，標普500指數則升0.5%。量子運算（IONQ、RGTI、QBTS）、核能（OKLO、LEU）及加密貨幣礦企（RIOT）等投機板塊短線動能強勁。然而，NVDA、MU、AMD等大型半導體股仍處於20日均線之下，反映升勢並不均衡，未算全面轉向風險偏好。今日數據並無附帶新聞標題，以上分析僅根據指數走勢及技術訊號。
